146.ch: Later views and life in Dallas

167.q: No, you didn't ride no horse back then. I went -- used to go -- did I go fishing? No, I never went fishing back then.

167.s: He fished off San Pedro to relax, and they talk of guitarist Tal Farlow, a fisherman and sign painter.
167.q: Oh, boy, it is. Very peaceful. That's why I used to go out there and just lay dead, you know? Although I wasn't dead, but I'd just lay there and had my hook, and someone would say, 'Hey, you got a bite. You got a bite.' I'd go over there and there'd be a fish on it.

139.q: I won $40 one night. I won $40 one night. At Lady Conway on Luzin Avenue. I came back the next week for $130. I'm going to hit a bingo game.

649.s: Brief talk about where Floyd Jones lives in Chicago and his love of fishing.

791.s: Her hobbies and how Tai Chi relates to playing.
